A prayer which increases writing quality over several days, if you have the minimum {{Church Rating}} required for its quality.

To unlock the recipe you need to unlock [[Book Writing (Tech Tree)|Writing Tricks]] in the technology tree. It can be crafted at the [[Desk]] or [[Desk II]].

==Effect==

Grants "[[file:Imagination effect.png]] inspiration" buff for a static +0.7 star rating for written crafts no matter the quality of the prayer.
